name: aeko-plugin
description: AEKO skills for Codex: zero-account site and PDP audits, PDP HTML builds, connector-aware ads and GA4 measurement, connection setup, and weekly read-and-propose reporting; optional AEKO workflows add AI visibility, prompt, content, store, and guarded OpenAI Ads operations. Brand customization is portable; content ideas require live MCP capabilities, and plugin scheduled marketing writes are unsupported.

interface.shortDescription: Audits, PDP builds, measurement, and read-and-propose weekly reporting
interface.longDescription: Start without an AEKO account: audit a public site or PDP, turn verified facts into responsive PDP HTML and JSON-LD, review advertising through your own connectors or exports, inspect GA4 through your own connector, map connected capability slots, and compose weekly reports and schedules. Optional AEKO workflows add AI-answer visibility, tracked evidence, content, store, action, and guarded OpenAI Ads operations. Brand skill/eval customization is portable. Content ideas require live MCP capabilities; plugin scheduled marketing writes are unsupported, so loop runs only read and propose. Hosted agent execution and the automatic brand updater are not implemented by this plugin.
defaultPrompt: Audit this product page, then rebuild its HTML.
Review last week's ads across my connected platforms.
Compose my weekly read-and-propose marketing report.
